name: WorldScore
description: WorldScore is the first unified benchmark for world generation that evaluates next-scene generation tasks with explicit camera trajectory-based layout specifications. It covers 3,000 test examples spanning diverse worlds including static and dynamic, indoor and outdoor, photorealistic and stylized, and evaluates generated worlds on controllability, quality, and dynamics.
reputation: A very recent benchmark that is likely to become a reference point for world generation, but is not yet broadly established in the community.
notes: Enables unified evaluation of 3D, 4D scene generation and video generation models with a leaderboard and evaluation code publicly available.
